422.description: More than 10,000 rows or 5 MB (import-too-large), or idempotency-key-reuse

info.title: WMS API
info.description: Warehouse Management System backend — modular monolith. This document is the contract: web and mobile clients generate typed clients from it (AD-8).

detail.example: Echo body must be a JSON object

accessToken.description: HS256 session token (15 min), claims: sub + tenant_id

blocked.description: true blocks the bin (broken); false unblocks

href.description: Deep link for the Continue affordance

inviteToken.description: The one-time invite token — share the accept link out-of-band

token.description: The one-time invite token from the invite response

skuCode.description: Absent when the row failed shape validation before a code could be read

detail.example: SKU code "MAS-CHILI-100" already exists in this tenant's catalog — duplicates are rejected, never merged.

committedRows.description: Rows committed in this run's single transaction

failedRows.description: Rows rejected with a row-level error

skippedRows.description: Rows skipped by fix mode (not in the latest run's failed set)

factor.description: Positive integer, relative to the SKU's base UoM
